items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring all blocking infrastructure is verified before parallel feature development commences.
The core shared infrastructure layer containing serialization and I/O helpers that block all subsequent user story implementations.
The high-level functional objective a user must achieve to satisfy a specific requirement.
A sequential alphanumeric token assigned to each entry to ensure unique reference and retrieval.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage in the home directory.
The minimum set of functional capabilities, specifically adding and completing entries, required for initial validation.
The structural grouping of implementation units by their corresponding user story to maintain independence.
The set of mandatory design documents and contracts required before implementation begins.
The primary documentation file detailing usage and storage behavior for the end user.
The initial phase involving package skeleton creation and tooling configuration.
The specific implementation unit responsible for handling empty collection states with a user-facing message.
The verification layer consisting of unit and integration directory structures.
The act of assigning a timestamp to the creation field during entry instantiation.
The operational command that purges all entries marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operational command that retrieves and displays all stored entries in human-readable or machine-parseable formats.
A high-priority constraint indicating that no subsequent work can proceed until the current phase is fully validated.
